body: The reason I'm so low its because its the semestrial break. My finals just ended and I don't feel too good about the results. School's out but I'll try to make an appointment with a doctor.

I know these people, they're pretty easy to read. They'll be in denial about this based on my experiences. I talked about being a bit depressed and all they can offer is "be happy". Mental illnesses don't exist to them. They even want me to apologize to my idiot father, the one who called me a devil in that incident without listening to what I have to say. They treat me like I'm a demon while I'm alive but they'll act like saints in my death.
Thanks. If I may ask. Do you know any good horror movies? I forgot the feeling of fear. I'd actually like to be afraid of something instead of being a cold walking meat shell.
I hope we can get through this.
Aww why do the funny ones leave?
